basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Bengaluru, India. I work as a software developer for a leading tech company and spend my evenings exploring the latest in gaming technology and online communities. I'm passionate about both Indian and global gaming scenes, and I enjoy helping others navigate the complex world of tech purchases. In a long-term relationship, I often game with my partner and friends during weekends. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work, around 8 PM to midnight IST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a formal education in Computer Science from a reputed Indian university, I've been a tech enthusiast since my early teens. I have extensive experience in coding and software development, which I apply to my gaming and tech hobbies. My expertise also comes from years of self-teaching and participating in online communities, where I stay updated with the latest tech trends and gaming strategies.
